hazards.control: Instrument power isolated before sensor changes; cables routed off the ground.

tabs.overview: A frac hit shows as a pressure rise on the offset while a stage is pumped; the treater and the engineer decide whether to change the schedule or protect the parent well.
tabs.engineering: Surface gauges on the tree; downhole gauges on wireline or the tubing where the well is shut in.
tabs.safety: Offset well valves confirmed closed before the frac.
tabs.evidence: Field practice at the frac van and wellsite instrumentation (S9); pressure transducer practice (S31 missile patent for header instruments); no vendor data.

name: Offset well pressure gauges (frac hit monitoring)
function: Pressure gauges on the wellheads of neighboring wells (or downhole gauges in them) that show when a fracture reaches them.
